book.name: 2 TESALONAIKA
book.title: Tesalonaika wali Leta Labuina Pol wana Leleli

content: Nau Pol alowau Sailasa ge Timoti leta ya ha leli ge ha patuna i nowa ekelesiya Tesalonaika eliyamiu, komiu ku minaa Yehoba Tamala ge Babala Yeisu Keliso eliyalil.
Ha awanun Yehoba Tamala ge Babala Yeisu Keliso nihi muloluagimiu ge wali nuwa laumwal atemiu ni pakalaopop.
Pol I Ba Tobal ge I Awanun Tesalonaika kaiweliya

Talimeyau ge numeyau, sauga gegewena kaiwemiu ha ba mulolu Yehoba elana. Bosowaima hot naha ginol ola, kaiwena wami abulilek i siun iyaka i gasisi hot, ge komiu maisena ge maisena wami nunuwana alomiyau elal i bwatabwata ya.
Inoke ha ba heyagimiu Yehoba wana ekelesiya elal. Wali wasa ha pek te bwagana hi apapanak-agimiu ge palopalomwan ku pwawa, yaa ku palahikan ge wami abulilek i gasisi.

Wami palahikan ge wami abulilek i pankitela te bwaliga Yehoba gamagalau wali pagan ni hile paolaolaek. He komiu Yehoba ni awa wawaisi-agimiu ge ni ba nuku ulutuk wana abaloguguiya, kaiwena lomwan ku pwawa abalogugui o kaiwena.
Yehoba iya toyatala sasapona: bolo hi palomwanagimiu lahena lomwan ni pek elal,
ge komiu bolo ku lomwan ni paveyaho-agimiu, ge i ola al ama ni paveyaho-agima. Yehoba ni ginol ola o, sauga ebo Babala Yeisu ni masalem labulabumwa alonau ge wana aneloseyau gasigasisel.
Ginebi ge ginaha tautauina ni nem, ge bolo Yehoba hi towani ge wala Babala Yeisu Wasana Waiwaisana nige hi hehenapu-an ali lahi ni pek.
Ali lahi te apapanak mihomihotina nihi pwawa. Ali bwaga ni gan Babala manininaa ge wana gasisi wawasana mwananalina elana.

Bugul bolo ya nihi gan lan toto Babala ni sikalim, inoke wana gamagalau bwabwalel, heliya gamagalau gegewel bolo hi abulilek elana, nihi awa wasawasa-an ge nihi awatauwan. He komiu al ge iyoho to boda o gamwanaa, kaiwena wasa toto ha wasaan eliyamiu ku abulilek-an.

Bugul bolo o ha nuwatuagil inoke sauga gegewena ha awaawanun kaiwemiu. Ha awanun te Yehoba ni labemiu ge bosowaimiu yawal toto kaiwena ge i yogaagimiu, elana nuku nanawaa. Ha awanun te wana gasisi eliyana ni labemiu, inoke waisi toto nuwamiu nuku ginol ge tuwalali waiwaisana toto i neem wami abulilek elana nuku awaawaginol.

Ha awanun ola to, inoke komiu kaiwemiu gamagalau wala Babala Yeisu alana nihi awa wasawasa-an, ge iya ni pawasawasa-agimiu. Toto ya i neem wala Yabowaine ge wala Babala Yeisu Keliso wali mulolu elana.
